title: Air Pollution and Student Learning in Pakistan

title_primary: 空气污染与巴基斯坦学生的学习
title_secondary: Air Pollution and Student Learning in Pakistan
authors: Asad, Saher, Behrer, A. Patrick, Heger, Martin Philipp, Yanez Pagans, Monica
source: World Bank Policy Research Working Papers
official: 官方在线 2026-09-22 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Ambient air pollution is a major health risk, but its implications for human capital formation are not well understood, particularly in low- and middle-income countries where exposure is high. This paper estimates the causal effect of sustained exposure to fine particulate matter on primary-school learning in rural Punjab, Pakistan. The paper combines longitudinal student achievement data from the Learning and Educational Achievements in Punjab Schools project with high-resolution satellite-based fine particulate matter estimates. To address endogeneity of pollution to local economic activity, the analysis exploits plausibly exogenous variation generated by open burning of agricultural residue interacted with wind direction, constructing school-year measures of upwind fire exposure as instruments for local fine particulate matter. The instrumental variable estimates show that higher school-year fine particulate matter significantly slows learning, with larger effects in mathematics than in language subjects. The results are consistent with impacts operating during instructional months: pollution exposure during the school year predicts lower achievement, while exposure during vacation months has little explanatory power. The findings show statistically imprecise heterogeneity by age and gender, opposite to patterns found in comparable settings. The analysis is organized around a simple framework in which learning depends on attendance, cognition, effort, and instructional quality, each a function of exposure to poor air quality. Pollution increases student absences, but this attendance channel explains only a small portion of the total effect, implying that most of the learning loss is non-attendance-related and likely operates through the framework’s other channels — direct effects on cognition, reduced effort, and degraded instructional quality.
abstract_zh: 环境空气污染是一项重大健康风险，但其对人力资本形成的影响尚未得到充分理解，尤其是在暴露水平较高的低收入和中等收入国家。本文估计了持续暴露于细颗粒物对巴基斯坦旁遮普农村地区小学学习的因果效应。本文将旁遮普学校学习与教育成就项目的学生纵向成绩数据与高分辨率卫星细颗粒物估计数据相结合。为解决污染对当地经济活动的内生性问题，分析利用了农业秸秆露天焚烧与风向交互所产生的看似外生变异，构建了学校—年份的上风向火灾暴露指标，作为当地细颗粒物的工具变量。工具变量估计表明，较高的学年细颗粒物显著减缓学习，且对数学的影响大于对语言类学科的影响。结果与影响在教学月份发挥作用的机制一致：学年期间的污染暴露预测了更低的成绩，而假期月份的暴露则几乎没有解释力。研究发现，按年龄和性别划分的异质性在统计上不精确，且与可比情境中发现的模式相反。分析围绕一个简单框架组织，其中学习取决于出勤、认知、努力和教学质量，而每一者都是暴露于不良空气质量的函数。污染增加了学生缺勤，但这一出勤渠道仅能解释总效应的一小部分，这意味着大部分学习损失与非出勤因素有关，并可能通过该框架的其他渠道发挥作用——对认知的直接影响、努力减少以及教学质量下降。

abstract: The paper examines opportunities for deeper economic integration between the EU and the Western Balkans and assesses their potential economic impact. It documents key non-tariff barriers to Western Balkan–EU industrial goods trade—covering regulatory, customs, and border-logistics frictions—amounting to around 8–14 percent ad valorem equivalent. Reducing these barriers, alongside deeper agri-food and services integration, could generate substantial gains, allowing the Western Balkans to capture roughly one-quarter to one-half of the economic benefits of full EU membership while supporting EU objectives related to nearshoring, supply-chain resilience, regional integration, and connectivity.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了欧盟与西巴尔干地区深化经济一体化的机遇，并评估其潜在经济影响。文章记录了西巴尔干与欧盟工业品贸易中的关键非关税壁垒——涵盖监管、海关和边境物流摩擦——其从价等值约为8%至14%。降低这些壁垒，并辅以更深入的农食产品和服务业一体化，可产生可观收益，使西巴尔干地区能够获得欧盟正式成员资格经济益处的约四分之一至一半，同时支持欧盟在近岸外包、供应链韧性、区域一体化和互联互通方面的目标。

title: Innovation Is Not Enough: Complementary Capabilities and Export Upgrading — Global Product-Level Evidence with an Application to Thailand

title_primary: 创新不足：互补能力与出口升级——基于全球产品层面证据及泰国应用

source: World Bank Policy Research Working Papers
official: 官方在线 2026-09-14 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Integration into global value chains can drive rapid industrialization without necessarily building the technological capabilities needed for sustained upper-middle-income growth. Using Thailand as a diagnostic case and global country–product–year data, we link PATSTAT patent and citation records to HS6 trade flows through a probabilistic technology–product concordance and derive a structural-gravity measure of export capability. Three findings emerge. First, Thailand’s established manufacturing export base coexists with an innovation base concentrated in applied, downstream activities rather than upstream and science-intensive technologies. Second, innovation intensity is positively associated with exports and export capability, particularly in digital and semiconductor products. Third, in the log-export interactions, this relationship is stronger where human capital and logistics perform better and, in several technology-intensive product groups, where policy uncertainty is lower. Evidence from Thai electric-vehicle and electronics producers identifies certification, customs and logistics, documentation, skills, and dependence on external partners—rather than tariffs—as practical constraints on capability deepening. Although the results are descriptive rather than causal, they show the complementary conditions under which technological accumulation is more closely connected to export upgrading. For middle-income economies, the challenge after entering global value chains is therefore to build the domestic capabilities and institutions needed to move beyond assembly and sustain productivity growth.
abstract_zh: 融入全球价值链可以推动快速工业化，却未必能建立起维持中高收入增长所需的技术能力。本文以泰国为诊断案例，利用全球国家—产品—年份数据，通过概率性技术—产品对应关系将PATSTAT专利与引用记录链接至HS6贸易流，并推导出一种结构引力测度的出口能力指标。研究得出三点发现。第一，泰国既有的制造业出口基础与集中于应用型、下游活动而非上游和科学密集型技术的创新基础并存。第二，创新强度与出口及出口能力正相关，在数字和半导体产品中尤为明显。第三，在对数出口交互项中，这种关系在人力资本和物流表现更好的地方更强，并且在若干技术密集型产品组中，在政策不确定性较低的地方也更强。来自泰国电动汽车和电子产品生产商的证据表明，认证、海关与物流、单证、技能以及对外部合作伙伴的依赖——而非关税——是能力深化的实际约束。尽管这些结果属于描述性而非因果性，但它们揭示了技术积累与出口升级联系更紧密所需的互补条件。因此，对中等收入经济体而言，进入全球价值链之后的挑战在于建设超越组装环节并维持生产率增长所需的国内能力与制度。

authors: Francesco Fusari
source: Journal of Economic Dynamics and Control
official: 官方在线 2026-09-12 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This paper develops a novel measure of monetary shocks that accounts for the endogenous response of the Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC) to higher moments of expected economic outcomes. First, I use quantile regression to estimate the conditional distribution of Federal Reserve forecasts and construct indicators of uncertainty and skewness. Second, I show that, unlike other measures proposed in the literature, these indicators have strong predictive power for the changes in the Federal funds rate deliberated by the FOMC. This suggests that point forecasts alone do not fully capture the FOMC’s systematic response to the economic outlook, with implications for the identification of monetary policy shocks. In particular, once higher moments are controlled for, the response of macroeconomic and financial variables is more closely aligned with theoretical predictions.
abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种新的货币冲击度量方法，该方法考虑了联邦公开市场委员会（FOMC）对预期经济结果高阶矩的内生反应。首先，我使用分位数回归估计美联储预测的条件分布，并构建不确定性和偏度的指标。其次，我表明，与文献中提出的其他度量方法不同，这些指标对FOMC所审议的联邦基金利率变化具有强预测能力。这表明，仅凭点预测并不能完全捕捉FOMC对经济前景的系统性反应，这对货币政策冲击的识别具有重要意义。特别地，一旦控制高阶矩，宏观经济和金融变量的反应与理论预测更加一致。

title_primary: 企业贡献与政治选拔：来自巴西的证据

authors: Julieta Peveri
source: Journal of Economic Behavior and Organization
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-09-12 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This paper studies the influence of corporate contributions on political selection and electoral outcomes. To identify the effects, I analyze a Brazilian reform that banned firms’ contributions using a weighted difference-in-differences strategy, exploiting variation in candidates’ reliance on corporate funding prior to the reform. I find that the ban fosters political competition by encouraging challengers and new candidates to run for office. Instead, the reform penalizes incumbents funded by firms by decreasing their likelihood of re-election. These adverse effects are particularly pronounced among underperforming incumbents. I also show that firms tend to donate more to mayors associated with higher corruption, a pattern that does not emerge for other donor types.
abstract_zh: 本文研究企业捐款对政治选拔和选举结果的影响。为识别其效应，我分析了一项禁止企业捐款的巴西改革，采用加权双重差分策略，并利用改革前候选人对企业资金依赖程度的差异。我发现，该禁令通过鼓励挑战者和新候选人竞选公职，促进了政治竞争。相反，该改革惩罚了由企业资助的现任者，降低了其连任的可能性。这些不利效应在表现不佳的现任者中尤为明显。我还表明，企业往往向与更高腐败程度相关的市长捐赠更多，而这一模式在其他捐赠者类型中并未出现。

authors: Philip Fliers, John Turner, Lloyd Maphosa
official: 官方在线 2026-08-31 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: In this paper, we examine the transplantation of British company law into the Cape Colony in the late nineteenth century. The Cape Colony Companies Act of 1892 was like its British counterpart in that it provided minimal investor protection. This meant that promoters were free to choose the level and types of shareholder safeguards in their company’s articles of association. We analyse the shareholder protection offered in the articles of Cape Colony companies established in the decade after 1892. We find that Cape companies offered higher protection than British ones. They were also much more likely to adopt the gold-standard blueprint articles of association from the Act’s appendix. We find that companies adopting these blueprint articles had more diffuse ownership but lower survival rates, suggesting trade-offs between investor protection and corporate longevity in the Cape Colony.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了19世纪末英国公司法在开普殖民地的移植情况。1892年的开普殖民地《公司法》与其英国对应法案相似，仅提供了最低限度的投资者保护。这意味着发起人可以自由选择其公司章程中股东保障的水平与类型。我们分析了1892年后十年间成立的開普殖民地公司章程中所提供的股东保护。研究发现，开普公司提供的保护水平高于英国公司，且它们更可能采纳该法案附录中的黄金标准蓝本公司章程。我们发现，采用这些蓝本章程的公司股权更为分散，但存活率较低，这表明在开普殖民地，投资者保护与公司长期存续之间存在权衡取舍。

abstract: This study examines the impact of payroll-tax enforcement on firm dynamism and its implications for aggregate productivity. We exploit China’s Social Security Collection Agency Reform, which transferred responsibility for collecting social-insurance contributions from local social-insurance agencies to tax authorities, thereby strengthening enforcement. We show that the reform increased firms’ social-insurance contributions, shifted workers toward informal employment without reducing overall nonagricultural employment, and reduced new firm entry while weakening incumbent firms’ profitability and investment. Overall, the reform reduced measured aggregate productivity in China’s registered, above-scale industrial sector by 3.3 percent, with entry into the above-scale industrial sector accounting for about 45 percent of the estimated decline.
abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了工资税征管对企业活力及其对总体生产率的影响。我们利用中国社会保险征缴机构改革，该改革将社会保险缴费的征收职责从地方社会保险机构转移至税务部门，从而加强了征管力度。研究表明，该改革增加了企业的社会保险缴费，促使劳动力转向非正规就业而未减少总体非农就业，同时降低了新企业进入率，并削弱了现有企业的盈利能力和投资。总体而言，该改革使中国登记注册的规模以上工业部门的测算总体生产率下降了3.3%，其中进入规模以上工业部门对估计下降的贡献约占45%。

title: Powering progress: Clean energy and industrialization as pathways to sustainable development in Asia
title_zh: 助力进步：清洁能源与工业化作为亚洲可持续发展的路径
title_primary: 助力进步：清洁能源与工业化作为亚洲可持续发展的路径

authors: Shailender Singh, Meenakshi Kaul, Chandrashekhar J. Rawandale, Muhammad Muazu Bala
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-08-28 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This study examines how clean energy access, renewable energy consumption, industrialization, and population dynamics contribute to sustainable development across 18 Asian countries over the period 1990–2023. This study employs an extended Solow growth framework to investigate these relationships, while the Sustainable Development Proxy Index integrates economic, social, and environmental dimensions of development. The empirical analysis applies Panel-Corrected Standard Errors (PCSE) and Feasible Generalized Least Squares (FGLS), complemented by panel cointegration and Dumitrescu–Hurlin causality tests. The findings indicate that access to clean cooking technologies and renewable energy are positively associated with sustainable development in the full sample, although the strength of these relationships varies across regions. In particular, access to clean cooking technologies does not exhibit statistically significant evidence of an association with sustainable development in Southeast Asia, whereas renewable energy shows a more consistent positive relationship. Evidence on population growth is mixed across specifications, particularly in South Asia, and therefore does not support interpreting population growth as a uniformly robust determinant of sustainable development. Industrialization exhibits greater importance in South Asia than in Southeast Asia. These findings highlight substantial regional heterogeneity and suggest that sustainable development policies should be adapted to regional conditions rather than based on uniform assumptions about the effects of clean energy, industrialization, and demographic change.
abstract_zh: 本研究考察了1990—2023年间，清洁能源可及性、可再生能源消费、工业化与人口动态如何促进18个亚洲国家的可持续发展。本研究采用扩展的索洛增长框架考察这些关系，同时可持续发展代理指数整合了发展的经济、社会和环境维度。实证分析应用面板校正标准误（PCSE）与可行广义最小二乘法（FGLS），并辅以面板协整检验和Dumitrescu–Hurlin因果检验。研究结果表明，在全体样本中，清洁烹饪技术可及性与可再生能源同可持续发展呈正相关，尽管这些关系的强度因区域而异。具体而言，在东南亚，清洁烹饪技术可及性未显示出与可持续发展存在统计学显著关联的证据，而可再生能源则表现出更为一致的正向关系。关于人口增长的证据在不同设定下并不一致，尤其是在南亚，因此不支持将人口增长解释为可持续发展的统一稳健决定因素。工业化在南亚的重要性高于东南亚。这些发现凸显了显著的区域异质性，并表明可持续发展政策应根据区域条件加以调整，而不应基于关于清洁能源、工业化和人口变化效应的统一假设。

title: When Do Secondary Stakeholder Attacks Matter to Financial Analysts? The Role of Analysts’ Political Ideology
title_zh: 次级利益相关者攻击何时影响财务分析师？分析师政治意识形态的作用
title_primary: 次级利益相关者攻击何时影响财务分析师？分析师政治意识形态的作用
title_secondary: When Do Secondary Stakeholder Attacks Matter to Financial Analysts? The Role of Analysts’ Political Ideology
authors: Mohammad Sadri, Ali Mohammadi, Pooyan Khashabi
official: 官方在线 2026-04-27 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Secondary stakeholders increasingly seek to discipline firms by attacking morally contested corporate actions. In this paper, we focus on a specific and consequential outcome of their attacks: shaping financial analysts’ recommendations. Drawing on research on moral evaluations and political ideology, we theorize that secondary stakeholder attacks increase analysts’ likelihood of issuing ‘sell’ recommendations, but that this effect is stronger among liberal analysts compared to their conservative peers. We further argue that this ideological divergence is amplified when analysts have greater reputational discretion to issue recommendations based on moral values, and when attacks concern violations that are less intrinsic to the firm’s core business and therefore more unexpected. We test these arguments using a novel dataset combining hand-collected information on analysts’ political ideology with data on secondary stakeholder attacks targeting publicly traded defense firms in the U.S. from 1998 to 2017. Our results support the theoretical predictions and further show that liberal analysts’ stronger responses to SSAs do not translate into superior returns. These findings also help explain the heterogeneous effectiveness of SSAs in capital markets.

abstract: We investigate how fertility relates to work from home (WFH) in the post-pandemic era, drawing on original data from our Global Survey of Working Arrangements and U.S. Survey of Working Arrangements and Attitudes. Realized fertility from 2023 to 2025 and future planned fertility are higher among adults who WFH at least one day a week and, for couples, higher yet when both partners do so. abstract: We develop a nonlinear model in which trend inflation and inflation tail risks emerge endogenously in equilibrium from the interaction between the primary deficit and the risk of supply disruptions. The key friction is limited fiscal responsibility: the government stabilizes debt in the long run but, unwilling to let debt accumulate too quickly, pressures the central bank to restrain interest-rate increases rather than adjust its own budget. The fiscal limit binds asymmetrically across shocks, with inflationary supply shocks especially likely to push monetary policy against the constraint. As supply-shock volatility rises and fiscal space narrows, the constraint binds more often. Anticipating this, agents raise their inflation expectations, causing trend inflation and upside inflation tail risks to rise even before the constraint binds. Movements in supply-shock volatility and fiscal space together account for much of the ratcheting up and down of U.S. trend inflation between 1965 and 1990. Interpreted through the model, the post-pandemic rise in long-run inflation expectations reflects a higher probability of fiscally constrained monetary policy.
abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个非线性模型，其中趋势通胀与通胀尾部风险通过基本赤字与供给中断风险的相互作用在均衡中内生形成。核心摩擦在于有限财政责任：政府虽在长期内稳定债务，但因不愿让债务过快累积，转而施压央行限制利率上调而非调整自身预算。财政约束对不同冲击呈现非对称约束效应——通胀性供给冲击尤其容易迫使货币政策触碰该约束。随着供给冲击波动率上升与财政空间收窄，约束触发频率显著增加。预期到这一机制，经济主体提前上调通胀预期，导致趋势通胀与上行通胀尾部风险在约束实际生效前已然攀升。1965年至1990年间，供给冲击波动率与财政空间的协同变动，解释了美国趋势通胀大部分阶梯式升降现象。通过模型解读，后疫情时期长期通胀预期的上升，反映了财政约束型货币政策发生概率的提高。

abstract: this paper, we examine a new survey of 6,010 United States households and estimate a model for the allocation of total net worth among different assets. The paper has three main aims. The first is to investigate the extent to which a conventional portfolio choice model can explain the differences in portfolio composition among households. Our survey data show that most households hold only a subset of the available assets. Hence we analyze a model in which investors choose to hold incomplete portfolios. We show that the empirical specification of the joint discrete and continuous choice that characterizes household portfolio behaviour is a switching regressions model with endogenous switching. The second aim is to examine the impact of taxes on portfolio composition. The survey contains a great deal of information on taxable incomes and deductions which enable us to calculate rather precisely the marginal tax rate facing each household. The third aim is to estimate wealth elasticities of demand for a range of assets and liabilities. We test the frequently made assumption of constant relative risk aversion.

abstract: This paper presents a model of how organizations develop complex products. Decentralizing the process into autonomous units increases the potential value of production but raises the risk of miscoordination. The organization coordinates the process through costly and imperfectly reliable coordination channels. It optimally creates redundancy in these channels, thereby determining the robustness of the process to miscoordination. The incentive to invest in robustness strengthens as long as returns to decentralization are increasing. Hence, organizations either centralize processes or decentralize them substantially to exploit increasing returns to decentralization. Small reductions in coordination costs can trigger substantial decentralization and, paradoxically, undermine process reliability. Larger reductions in coordination costs also enhance reliability.

abstract: We prove that a two-cycle equilibrium in a general equilibrium model with infinitely-lived agents (GEILA) constitutes an equilibrium in an overlapping generations (OLG) model. abstract: We examine how son preference affects women’s mental health across generations using original survey data from extended households in rural India. Leveraging exogenous variation in the sex of the firstborn child, we find that mothers-in-law (MILs) whose co-resident daughter-in-law (DIL) had a firstborn son face a 15 percent lower risk of anxiety or depression. In contrast, firstborn sex has no average effect on DIL mental health, although adverse effects of not having a son emerge among older DILs who face a closing reproductive window. We also find that a DIL’s firstborn son shifts MIL time allocation toward childcare and increases her support for DIL employment when children are young, boosting younger DILs’ labor force participation. These findings reveal an intergenerational pathway linking son preference to women’s mental health, intrahousehold dynamics, and economic outcomes beyond fertility alone.

abstract: Developing countries host roughly 90% of global mangrove forests but face systemic barriers to international carbon market participation because measurement and methodological uncertainties compound across accounting standards. This study develops an uncertainty propagation framework that traces these uncertainties from remote sensing identification through carbon accounting to credit valuation, using China’s mangrove restoration projects as a case study. Integrating 10 remote sensing products with ground-truth validation, we quantify spatial uncertainty patterns in 2020, yielding a 3.73:1 ratio between uncertain and high-certainty mapping areas under conservative unanimous-agreement rule. These measurement uncertainties compound with methodological discrepancies across three carbon accounting standards, China Certified Emission Reduction (CCER), Verified Carbon Standard (VCS), and Gold Standard (GS), generating 2.1-fold variations in carbon reduction estimates for identical mangrove areas. We use Monte Carlo simulations to further trace how these combined uncertainties propagate through carbon pricing mechanisms, yielding market valuations spanning $0.79-$11.91 million for 2020 Chinese mangrove carbon credits across international markets. Our findings point to a mechanism by which technical measurement challenges, combined with divergence between domestic and international standards, could substantially constrain carbon market viability for developing countries with similar national contexts to China. Targeted methodological harmonization and cross-standard coordination could therefore be important for enhancing equitable market access and enabling developing countries to scale nature-based climate solutions.

official: 来源期次 Land Use Policy, Volume 168 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Flood management in complex watersheds that include both urban and natural areas presents significant challenges due to the contrasting hydrological and hydraulic dynamics of these regions. This study proposes an integrated framework that combines Green Infrastructure (GI) in urban areas with detention dams in upstream nonurban regions to mitigate flood risks comprehensively. Using the Wadi Al-Sarami watershed in Oman as a case study, the research employs multi-objective optimization algorithms to design and evaluate potential scenarios for both interventions. Detention dams were optimized to reduce peak flow entering urban areas, while GI measures were configured to enhance infiltration and manage local runoff. The scenarios were then integrated to develop macro-level flood management plans that implement a balanced approach across the watershed. A cooperative game theory framework was applied to resolve conflicts among key stakeholders, namely the Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries, and Water Resources (MAFWR), Sohar Municipality (SM), and urban residents. This study also applied Shapley and Tau value methods for allocation to ensure a fair distribution of benefits among the stakeholders and to encourage cooperation. The results indicated that the integrated approach could achieve a peak flow reduction of up to 72.5% and a 71.8% decrease in urban runoff volume. This paper presents a framework that shows that technical optimization needs to be integrated with stakeholder collaboration for sustainable flood management. This research provides a scalable and adaptable solution for addressing the increasing flood risks associated with urbanization in complex watersheds.

abstract: Productivity growth is essential for securing the long‐term profitability and competitiveness of pasture‐based dairy systems, particularly amid volatile input and output prices and increasing environmental constraints. This paper measures productivity growth using a total factor productivity index (TFPI) tailored to the seasonal, pasture‐based nature of New Zealand dairy farming. We apply a proper‐index approach to enable meaningful comparisons across time and farms. The TFPI is decomposed into key components: technological progress, scale and input‐mix efficiency, technical efficiency, production environment and statistical noise. To account for climate‐related variability, we integrate pasture growth indices as proxies for pasture availability supporting milksolids (fat + protein) production. Between 2012/2013 and 2023/2024, productivity growth plateaued, with the TFPI declining by 1.33% (−0.09% per annum). While technological progress increased by 6.9%, this was offset by declines in scale‐and‐mix efficiency (−4.2%), technical efficiency (−0.63%) and production environment favourability (−1.68%). Moreover, technological progress has stagnated since 2015/2016, suggesting that recent innovations have not translated into measurable productivity gains. These findings underscore the need for a multifaceted response to reverse productivity decline and secure competitiveness: accelerating innovation, strengthening technology adoption and building environmental resilience.

title: Designing emissions trading schemes for a price-regulated and concentrated industry: Insights from China’s power sector

title_primary: 面向价格管制与集中型行业的碳排放交易机制设计：来自中国电力部门的启示
title_secondary: Designing emissions trading schemes for a price-regulated and concentrated industry: Insights from China’s power sector
authors: Dong-Hyuk Kim, Hui Qiao, Ying Zheng
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-06 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This paper proposes a framework for designing an emissions trading system (ETS) for the highly concentrated and regulated Chinese electricity forward markets. We present an economic model where a few generation firms maximize profits by choosing output levels under a price set below equilibrium and engage in trading carbon permits under either tradable performance standards (TPS) or cap-and-trade (C&T) systems. The regulated price causes underproduction across all firms. Compared to a scenario with no ETS, both ETS depress permit buyers’ production, and C&T typically decreases sellers’ production unless initial allocations are excessively high. However, TPS encourages permit sellers’ production if a seller cannot drastically shift the permit market equilibrium. From a Guangdong dataset, we uncover model parameters, such as firm-specific cost functions, and use them to evaluate policy scenarios. We find TPS achieves higher welfare with lower emissions than C&T under the regulated price. If the price is jointly selected with the ETS to maximize welfare, both achieve almost identical welfare and emission levels, but TPS has more consumer surplus than C&T. Moreover, TPS under the regulated price approximates this maximized welfare, counteracting the underproduction by reallocating generation to low-emission-intensity firms, whereas C&T requires substantially higher power and permit prices.
abstract_zh: 本文提出一个框架，旨在为高度集中且受监管的中国电力远期市场设计排放交易体系（ETS）。我们构建了一个经济模型，其中少数发电企业在低于均衡水平的价格设定下，通过选择产出水平来实现利润最大化，并在可交易绩效标准（TPS）或总量控制与交易（C&T）体系下进行碳配额交易。受监管的价格导致所有企业生产不足。与无ETS情景相比，两种ETS均抑制了配额买方的生产，而C&T通常减少卖方的生产，除非初始分配过高。然而，若卖方无法大幅改变配额市场均衡，TPS则鼓励配额卖方的生产。基于广东数据集，我们揭示了模型参数，如企业特定成本函数，并利用这些参数评估政策情景。我们发现，在受监管价格下，TPS相比C&T能实现更高福利和更低排放。若价格与ETS共同选择以最大化福利，两者在福利和排放水平上几乎相同，但TPS比C&T带来更多消费者剩余。此外，受监管价格下的TPS接近这种最大化福利，通过将发电重新分配给低排放强度企业来抵消生产不足，而C&T则需要显著更高的电力和配额价格。

title: Integrating large health shocks into life-cycle models - modelling impacts of a cancer diagnosis
title_zh: 将重大健康冲击纳入生命周期模型——癌症诊断影响的建模
title_primary: 将重大健康冲击纳入生命周期模型——癌症诊断影响的建模
title_secondary: Integrating large health shocks into life-cycle models - modelling impacts of a cancer diagnosis
authors: Michael Freiberger, Michael Kuhn, Stefan Wrzaczek
source: Journal of Economic Dynamics and Control
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-05-26 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Most models on the life-cycle utilization of health care consider the expected development of an individual’s health. However, health shocks with significant impact (e.g. the onset of a chronic disease or life-threatening accidents) should not be averaged, as they can put the life-course onto a different trajectory. This paper presents an optimal-control framework incorporating a stochastic health shock with individuals allocating their resources to consumption and various types of health care over their life-cycle. We distinguish between general health care and shock-specific prevention, acute, and chronic care. We investigate the optimal decisions (on consumption, saving, and health care) made in anticipation and the optimal reaction to the shock depending on the timing of its arrival. Furthermore, we extend the value of life concept to the multidimensionality of health and the scope for a shock and illustrate our findings by calibrating the model to an individual facing a potential cancer diagnosis in the US. In so doing we also investigate the role of possible bias in the subjective expectation of a health shock.
abstract_zh: 大多数关于生命周期内医疗保健利用的模型考虑的是个体健康状况的预期发展。然而，具有重大影响的健康冲击（如慢性疾病的发生或危及生命的事故）不应被平均化处理，因为它们可能将生命历程引向不同的轨迹。本文提出一个最优控制框架，纳入随机健康冲击，个体在其生命周期内将资源分配于消费及各类医疗保健。我们区分了一般医疗保健与针对冲击的预防、急性及慢性护理。我们研究了在预期冲击情况下做出的最优决策（涉及消费、储蓄及医疗保健），以及根据冲击发生时间而采取的最优应对措施。此外，我们将生命价值概念扩展至健康的多维性及冲击的影响范围，并通过将模型校准至美国面临潜在癌症诊断的个体来阐述我们的发现。在此过程中，我们还探讨了主观预期健康冲击中可能存在的偏差所起的作用。

title: The Liquidity of the Government Bond Market—What Impact Does Quantitative Easing Have? Evidence from Sweden
title_zh: 政府债券市场的流动性——量化宽松有何影响？来自瑞典的证据
title_primary: 政府债券市场的流动性——量化宽松有何影响？来自瑞典的证据
title_secondary: The Liquidity of the Government Bond Market—What Impact Does Quantitative Easing Have? Evidence from Sweden
authors: MARIANNA BLIX GRIMALDI, ALBERTO CROSTA, DONG ZHANG
source: Journal of Money, Credit and Banking
official: 官方在线 2026-05-21 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Quantitative easing (QE) introduced during the 2008 financial crisis, has since remained a key monetary policy tool. Our paper studies how QE affects market liquidity using unique data on Swedish government bonds. We find that there is a deterioration in the level of market liquidity from QE. This scarcity effect is nonlinear. Only after QE reaches a certain volume level, it outweighs the improvement in liquidity from boosting market demand. Unlike market prices, which often react to announcements, liquidity does not change when QE is announced. Instead, the liquidity effect occurs in connection with the actual purchases.
abstract_zh: 2008年金融危机期间引入的量化宽松政策（QE）此后一直是重要的货币政策工具。本文利用瑞典政府债券的独特数据，研究量化宽松如何影响市场流动性。我们发现量化宽松会导致市场流动性水平恶化。这种稀缺效应是非线性的：只有当量化宽松达到一定规模后，其对流动性的负面影响才会超过通过提振市场需求带来的改善效应。与通常对政策公告做出反应的市场价格不同，流动性在量化宽松宣布时并未发生变化，而是与实际购买行为相关联时才产生流动性效应。

title: The Effect of Brazil's Family Health Program on Cognitive Skills
title_zh: 巴西家庭健康计划对认知技能的影响
title_primary: 巴西家庭健康计划对认知技能的影响
title_secondary: The Effect of Brazil's Family Health Program on Cognitive Skills
authors: Pinar Mine Gunes, Magda Tsaneva
source: Oxford Bulletin of Economics and Statistics
official: 官方在线 2026-05-14 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This paper examines the effect of Brazil's Family Health Program (Programa Saude da Familia, FHP) on cognitive skills (measured by test scores) of fifth‐grade students. We use biennial data from national exams between 2007 and 2015, and variation in the FHP implementation date across municipalities, birth cohort, and test year to identify the effect of the program on language and mathematics test scores. In municipalities in the North and Northeast regions, students exposed to FHP at or before birth score 0.72 points higher in language and 0.98 points higher in mathematics than those first exposed later, corresponding to 0.0194 sd and 0.0259 sd in intent‐to‐treat estimates. We further show that early exposure to FHP is associated with improvements in test scores in municipalities with lower income and limited access to basic public health infrastructure, such as access to running water and sewage, providing further evidence that the program benefitted economically disadvantaged municipalities the most. Heterogeneity analyses reveal no significant differences by student gender or mother's education, but important differences by race, as the program effects are concentrated among mixed‐race and Black students. Our findings are consistent with health‐related channels playing an important role, rather than measured parental engagement, although the precise mechanisms cannot be directly identified with the available data.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了巴西家庭健康计划（Programa Saúde da Família，FHP）对五年级学生认知技能（以考试成绩衡量）的影响。我们使用2007年至2015年间全国考试的两年一度数据，以及各市镇FHP实施日期、出生队列和考试年份的变异，来识别该计划对语言和数学考试成绩的影响。在北部和东北部地区的市镇中，在出生时或出生前接触FHP的学生，其语言成绩比那些较晚才首次接触FHP的学生高0.72分，数学成绩高0.98分，在意向性治疗估计中分别对应0.0194个标准差和0.0259个标准差。我们进一步表明，在收入较低且基本公共卫生基础设施（如自来水和污水处理）获取有限的市镇中，早期接触FHP与考试成绩改善相关，这进一步证明该计划使经济上处于不利地位的市镇受益最大。异质性分析显示，学生性别或母亲教育程度没有显著差异，但按种族存在重要差异，因为计划效应集中在混血和黑人学生中。我们的发现与健康相关渠道发挥重要作用相一致，而非所测量的父母参与，尽管现有数据无法直接识别确切机制。

title: Strikes and Machines: Investments in the Norwegian Inter-War-Period
title_zh: 罢工与机器：挪威两次世界大战期间的投资
title_primary: 罢工与机器：挪威两次世界大战期间的投资
title_secondary: Strikes and Machines: Investments in the Norwegian Inter-War-Period
authors: Kotsadam, Andreas, Rasmussen, Magnus B., Moene 等
official: 官方在线 2026-04-30 · 来源：RSS
abstract: To what extent do strike threats prompt firms to adopt capital-intensive methods to deter strikes or labor-intensive strategies to maintain flexibility during work stoppages? We introduce a theoretical model that demonstrates how threats of industrial action influence capital investments through relative factor prices and the power dynamics between workers and employers. Using newly digitized data from 3,141 industrial conflicts and collective agreements in Norway during the interwar period, our findings indicate that strikes generally drive firms toward less capital-intensive technologies. This trend is particularly pronounced in conflicts resolved at the branch or national level, where strike threats may appear more exogenous to firms.
abstract_zh: 罢工威胁在多大程度上促使企业采用资本密集型方法以遏制罢工，或采取劳动密集型策略以在停工期间保持灵活性？我们引入了一个理论模型，展示了工业行动威胁如何通过相对要素价格以及工人与雇主之间的权力动态影响资本投资。利用一战期间挪威3,141起工业冲突和集体协议的新数字化数据，我们的研究结果表明，罢工通常促使企业转向资本密集度较低的技术。这一趋势在分支或国家层面解决的冲突中尤为显著，因为在这些情况下，罢工威胁对企业而言可能显得更具外生性。

title: Data portability and the collection of personal data
title_zh: 数据可携性与个人数据收集
title_primary: 数据可携性与个人数据收集
title_secondary: Data portability and the collection of personal data
authors: Youping Li, Jianhu Zhang
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-04-30 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: The right to data portability allows consumers to obtain and reuse their personal data across service providers. However, its effect on market competition is not clear-cut, as it impacts the firms’ incentives to collect data. Employing a two-period game-theoretic model in which consumer data collected by one firm in the first period can be transferred to the other firm in the second period, this paper analyzes the implications of data portability on competition and welfare. We find that by eliminating the data “lock-in” effect, data portability mitigates competition during data collection, although intensifying it afterward. Perhaps counterintuitively, the firms collect more data when data is portable. Moreover, they earn higher profits, whereas consumers may well be worse off. We identify the degree of market competition as a critical determinant of the welfare implications of data portability. Specifically, low (high) levels of competition are associated with improved (worsened) overall social welfare.
abstract_zh: 数据可携权允许消费者在不同服务提供商之间获取并重复使用其个人数据。然而，其对市场竞争的影响并非一目了然，因为它会影响企业收集数据的激励。通过构建一个两期博弈论模型，其中一家企业在第一期收集的消费者数据可在第二期转移给另一家企业，本文分析了数据可携权对竞争和福利的影响。我们发现，通过消除数据“锁定”效应，数据可携权缓解了数据收集阶段的竞争，尽管在后续阶段加剧了竞争。或许与直觉相悖的是，当数据可携时，企业会收集更多数据。此外，企业获得更高利润，而消费者可能反而受损。我们识别出市场竞争程度是决定数据可携权福利影响的关键因素。具体而言，低（高）竞争水平与整体社会福利的改善（恶化）相关联。

title: On Quantum Ambiguity and Potential Exponential Computational Speedups to Solving Dynamic Asset Pricing Models

abstract: We formulate quantum computing solutions to a large class of dynamic nonlinear asset pricing models using algorithms, in theory exponentially more efficient than classical ones, which leverage the quantum properties of superposition, entanglement, and interference. The equilibrium asset pricing solution is a quantum state. We use quantum decision-theoretic foundations of ambiguity and model/parameter uncertainty to deal with model selection.
abstract_zh: 我们利用量子计算解决方案，针对一大类动态非线性资产定价模型，采用在理论上比经典算法指数级更高效的算法，这些算法利用了叠加、纠缠和干涉的量子特性。均衡资产定价解表现为一个量子态。我们运用基于量子决策理论的模糊性及模型/参数不确定性处理框架，来应对模型选择问题。

title: Telegraph and capital market integration: Evidence from late imperial China
title_zh: 电报与资本市场一体化：来自晚清中国的证据
title_primary: 电报与资本市场一体化：来自晚清中国的证据
title_secondary: Telegraph and capital market integration: Evidence from late imperial China
authors: Yu Hao, Yuxiang Wang
official: 官方在线 2026-04-17 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Abstract Exploiting quasi‐exogenous variations in the timing of telegraph construction, the reduction of information costs promotes capital market integration in late imperial China. Employing a difference‐in‐differences strategy, we find that telegraph connection within a prefecture pair reduced the difference in interest rate by 1.27 percentage points. Institutional quality and transportation accessibility complemented telegraph's role in enhancing capital market integration. In addition, financial intermediaries augmented the telegraph's effect on capital market integration. For the traditional banks ( piaohao ), the augmenting effect was only salient within firm boundaries, suggesting that information was only exchanged within firm‐specific networks.
abstract_zh: 摘要 利用电报建设时间上的准外生变化，信息成本的降低促进了晚清中国的资本市场一体化。采用双重差分策略，我们发现府际电报连接使利率差异降低了1.27个百分点。制度质量与交通可达性对电报在增强资本市场一体化中的作用具有互补效应。此外，金融中介放大了电报对资本市场一体化的影响。对于传统票号而言，这种放大效应仅在企业边界内显著，表明信息仅在特定企业网络内部交换。

title: Cash Welfare and Health Spending
title_zh: 现金福利与健康支出
title_primary: 现金福利与健康支出
title_secondary: Cash Welfare and Health Spending
authors: Jeffrey Hicks
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-03-11 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Abstract I explore the interplay between cash welfare and health-related outcomes using Canadian administrative data. Healthcare use rises sharply before a welfare application, especially for plausibly work-limiting diagnoses, then partially normalizes within three years. Using application adjudicators’ decisions as "judge IVs", I estimate that welfare receipt has limited effects on subsequent health-related outcomes. Because Canadian healthcare is free and universal, these findings are unrelated to health insurance. An exception is pharmaceuticals, which are free for welfare recipients but not for non-recipients — consistent with this, welfare receipt strongly increases pharmaceutical use, implying that incomplete insurance limits medication among those excluded from welfare.
abstract_zh: 我利用加拿大行政数据探讨了现金福利与健康相关结果之间的相互作用。在申请福利之前，医疗保健使用量急剧上升，尤其是对于可能限制工作的诊断，随后在三年内部分恢复正常。利用申请裁决者的决定作为“法官工具变量”，我估计福利领取对后续健康相关结果的影响有限。由于加拿大医疗保健免费且普及，这些发现与健康保险无关。一个例外是药品，福利领取者免费获得药品，而非领取者则不然——与此一致的是，福利领取显著增加了药品使用，这表明不完整的保险限制了被排除在福利之外者的用药。

title: Economic globalization and income shares
title_zh: 经济全球化与收入份额
title_primary: 经济全球化与收入份额
title_secondary: Economic globalization and income shares
authors: Andreas Bergh, Christian Bjørnskov, Justin T. Callais
official: 官方在线 2026-03-11 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Low barriers to trade and access to international capital markets have long been argued to improve economic conditions in a country. However, there is less consensus on the impact of economic globalization on the distribution of those gains across society. There are several possible explanations for the conflicting findings in the existing literature, perhaps most notably endogeneity issues that plague the cross-country studies. To alleviate this, we utilize matching methods. Instead of using Gini coefficients, as much of the previous literature, we examine large increases in economic globalization’s impact on 5-year income growth in each quintile of the income distribution as well as top 1 and 5 percent. We find no evidence that income growth for the middle classes in OECD countries is hurt by economic globalization; if anything, some results indicate statistically positive effects. Most estimates, however, are positive but statistically and economically insignificant.

title: Retail Foreign Direct Investment by Brand Manufacturers
title_zh: 品牌制造商的零售外商直接投资
title_primary: 品牌制造商的零售外商直接投资
title_secondary: Retail Foreign Direct Investment by Brand Manufacturers
authors: Benedikt Herz, Russell Thomson
official: 官方在线 2025-12-23 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Many successful brand manufacturers, such as Apple and Nike, have invested extensively in international networks of direct retail outlets. Systematic evidence on this development has been lacking because official foreign direct investment (FDI) data are classified according to the main industry of the investing firm and therefore most branded retail investments are classified as manufacturing or wholesale trade. Using novel project-level data, we show that direct retail FDI now accounts for more than 5% of global FDI flows—about five times the FDI in official data. We provide empirical evidence that FDI in branded retail outlets is driven by brand owners’ need to control brand value, especially when it is difficult to contract and monitor sales and service quality.
abstract_zh: 许多成功的品牌制造商，如苹果和耐克，已大量投资于国际直营零售网络。由于官方外国直接投资（FDI）数据按投资企业的主要行业分类，因此大多数品牌零售投资被归类为制造业或批发贸易，导致这一发展的系统性证据一直缺失。利用新颖的项目级数据，我们表明直营零售FDI现占全球FDI流量的5%以上——约为官方数据中FDI的五倍。我们提供实证证据，表明品牌零售网点的FDI受品牌所有者控制品牌价值的需求驱动，尤其是在销售和服务质量难以契约化及监控的情况下。
